tests.description: Coordinates the shared compatibility and conformance gate for a candidate Build.
tests.previous_reason: Broad qualification or diagnostic entry point. Its original implementation is commented and the callable refuses, so disabled checks cannot yield a passing release claim.

tests.name: live

tests.name: info.identity
tests.reason: Checks identity emitted by the candidate executable against the external expected component, version and Build. Detects running the wrong installed/candidate program; transport scenarios compare answers without establishing this provenance.
tests.description: Info.identity.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: classify.what-is-sent
tests.reason: Runs the classifier against a recording HTTP server, checks exact received body/headers and absence of machine paths and hostname. Detects unintended metadata/credential transmission across the actual process and HTTP boundary; mocked transport checks cannot establish wire behavior.
tests.description: Classify.what-is-sent.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: classify.other-model
tests.reason: A real HTTP reply names a different or missing model; the executable must reject it after exactly one send. Prevents accepting an answer from an unpinned provider model, which successful wire and retry workflows do not challenge.
tests.description: Classify.other-model.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: classify.missing-answer
tests.reason: Feeds missing, extra and malformed answer sets through the process/HTTP boundary and checks rejection without retry. Prevents silently returning an incomplete or mismatched classification result; model-identity validation covers a different integrity invariant.
tests.description: Classify.missing-answer.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: classify.size-limit
tests.reason: Measures the bytes received by the server, then tests the exact limit, one byte below, and a larger prettified input. Establishes that the enforced limit is the transmitted body, not source text size; avoids a self-referential local serializer oracle.
tests.description: Classify.size-limit.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: classify.endpoint-elsewhere
tests.reason: Supplies an external endpoint and a real marker-writing credential command, then checks the marker never appears. Detects credential access before endpoint authorization; the peer-mismatch test acts later after resolution.
tests.description: Classify.endpoint-elsewhere.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: classify.writes-nothing
tests.reason: Snapshots candidate files, home and temporary directory around successful and refused real calls. Detects unintended persistence of private classification state; wire assertions cannot observe filesystem side effects.
tests.description: Classify.writes-nothing.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: key.not-found
tests.reason: Exercises missing/unreadable credentials and failed key subprocesses through the actual executable while a recording server observes zero requests. Detects unauthenticated sends and unwanted credential mutation, rather than just matching an error string.
tests.description: No key: no item, an empty item, an item that cannot be read, a key command that fails or prints nothing.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: key.only-in-the-bearer-token
tests.reason: Injects credentials into provider error echoes and inspects process output, request headers/body, security arguments/environment and settings. Detects leakage across several actual boundaries; the top-tier storage case covers only storing the secret.
tests.description: The key appears in no output, diagnostic, argument, environment or settings file: only in the bearer token.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: add-key.at-a-terminal
tests.reason: Exercises real PTY input, security subprocess storage, subsequent info/classify and key replacement, including quoting. Reads back stored and transmitted secrets independently. This is the representative credential lifecycle rather than separate setter/getter checks.
tests.description: add-key stores what was typed at the terminal; info then finds it, classify sends it; a second one replaces it.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: add-key.no-terminal
tests.reason: Starts the executable without a controlling terminal and supplies a key on stdin; observes refusal and zero security invocations. Prevents accepting credentials from an unintended input channel, which the successful PTY workflow cannot establish.
tests.description: Without a terminal add-key refuses, and takes no key from standard input.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: cli.build-entry
tests.reason: Invokes the candidate bin entry itself with a real key command and HTTP server. Verifies packaged import paths, CLI output and transport together; other contract scenarios use the instrumented entry and cannot detect a broken shipped launcher.
tests.description: The Build's own entry, bin/arbol-classifier, without the stand-in for security: a key command gives the key.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: errors.invalid-at-jev
tests.reason: Sends structured and textual provider errors that echo the judged private text; observes the executable output and one-send refusal. Detects disclosure through error normalization at the HTTP boundary, distinct from credential redaction.
tests.description: 422 and 413: invalid_input, with what Jev said, and never the judged text that Jev echoed.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: errors.rate-limited
tests.reason: A real HTTP 429 response exercises retry exhaustion and Retry-After propagation through the process output. Establishes the rate-limit contract across HTTP parsing and retry state, not the local status lookup table.
tests.description: Errors.rate-limited.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: errors.vendor-unavailable
tests.reason: Uses server disconnects and an actually closed port to verify bounded retries and the transport-failure result. Distinct from scripted HTTP status handling because a failed connection has no response body or status.
tests.description: 529, a status from 500 on, a connection closed without an answer, and an address where nothing listens.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: attempts.until-an-answer
tests.reason: Exercises transient statuses/disconnect followed by success, and transient followed by permanent failure, against a real server. Counts actual sends and validates the final result; covers retry state transitions beyond exhaustion and the top-tier deadline case.
tests.description: A further attempt after 529, 429, a status from 500 on or a closed connection, and the answer it brings.
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: limits.time-limit
tests.reason: Holds an HTTP response, drips bytes, stalls a key subprocess and leaves stdin open, observing bounded process completion and no premature sends. These real blocking boundaries can outlive per-read timeouts; a mocked deadline or sleep assertion does not establish termination.
tests.description: A Jev that does not answer, a slow key command and a request that does not end: limit_reached in time.
assertion_examples: process.stdin is not None and process.stdout is not None and (process.stderr is not None)
tests.previous_reason: Contract scenario with a multi-step fixture and compatibility assertions. Reserved for explicit qualification; this reset does not establish a reason to keep the whole scenario active.

tests.name: run_contract
tests.reason: Orchestration and fixture isolation for retained process/HTTP scenarios, plus filesystem immutability checks around info. Preserves candidate snapshot checking and reports the actual reduced scenario count; not a claim of historical full qualification.

tests.name: run_live

tests.name: test_no_wait_goes_past_the_time_limit
tests.reason: Puts the deadline between the first and second retry waits. Checks that the call returns the last vendor refusal after two sends instead of sleeping or retrying past the total budget.

tests.name: test_an_endpoint_on_this_mac_that_leads_elsewhere_is_refused_before_anything_is_sent
tests.reason: Injects a resolved non-loopback peer behind an allowed localhost URL and independently records zero HTTP requests and connection closure. Guards credential exfiltration after name resolution; the loopback HTTP scenarios cannot safely arrange this peer mismatch.
tests.description: An endpoint on this mac that leads elsewhere is refused before anything is sent.
tests.previous_reason: Scenario: an endpoint on this mac that leads elsewhere is refused before anything is sent. Disabled because no independently reviewed top-tier rationale was established for this case. Mid is provisional, not a verdict that every assertion is useful.

tests.name: test_the_key_goes_to_security_on_standard_input_never_as_an_argument
tests.reason: Records the security subprocess boundary and verifies the stored key through a later read. Detects credential exposure through process arguments or environment while still proving that storage worked.

tests.name: test_a_build_made_while_no_key_is_stored_fails_the_live_check
tests.reason: Uses the actual classifier entry and a subprocess Keychain stand-in with no credential to demonstrate that the live release gate fails. Distinct from successful contract calls: prevents false live qualification without reaching the provider.
tests.description: A build made while no key is stored fails the live check.
assertion_examples: self.assertIn(f'live: {stand_in.program} takes the place of /usr/bin/security', printed)

tests.name: test_corrupted_cached_distribution_is_refused_without_a_download
tests.reason: Places wrong bytes at the digest-named filesystem cache entry and observes rejection with no network fallback. Detects reuse of corrupted interpreter archives; manifest checking examines an already built package, not this download/cache boundary.
tests.description: Corrupted cached distribution is refused without a download.
tests.previous_reason: Scenario: corrupted cached distribution is refused without a download. Disabled because no independently reviewed top-tier rationale was established for this case. Mid is provisional, not a verdict that every assertion is useful.

tests.name: test_the_key_is_read_with_echo_off_and_the_terminal_is_set_back
tests.reason: A real PTY observes the bytes shown while entering a credential and compares termios before/after. Detects secret echo and terminal-state damage; the packaged add-key workflow cannot inspect the child terminal after exit.
tests.description: The key is read with echo off and the terminal is set back.
